subject: seedpod sailor character
requested_medium: painted seedpod and metal folk toy
art_direction: 干燥花荚像圆帽头，波浪叶领与短根脚，铬黄和深蓝漆面组合，神态硬气却可爱。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Design a small character from a dried rounded seedpod with a scalloped crown, using the pod as its entire head and upper body. A wavy leaf collar frames a small sturdy face, and short root-like feet support the form. Two stubby arms rest at its sides with a quietly defiant stance. Paint the pod in ochre and navy enamel, leaving some natural ridges exposed; add a tiny copper-colored collar clasp. Use a warm ivory studio field and soft light. Avoid nautical insignia, smoking references, realistic human anatomy, or a scenic setting. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
